hero.title: From idea to a plan you can show.
hero.lead: Know yourself, test a local business idea, then write the plan. moonx does the math and shows what is missing.

phases.title: Three parts, in the order founders need them.
phases.lead: Each part asks one question at a time and saves as you write, on your phone or on a bigger screen.

selfAnalysis.title: Self Analysis
selfAnalysis.description: Your strengths, your values and what you want from a business.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: Research, competitors and costs, then decide whether to go ahead, wait or drop it.

plan.title: Business plan
plan.description: Milestones, risks and a pitch deck built from what you validated.

numbers.title: The numbers move as you type.
numbers.lead: Enter costs and a price. Break-even, four scenarios and payback update on the spot.
numbers.bounds: Unknown and empty rows stay in view, and a total that is only a lower bound shows a +.

costs.label: Example startup costs with two known rows, one Unknown row and one Empty row, and totals

invitation.title: moonx is by invitation.
invitation.lead: Ask the person who invited you for your link. If you already have an account, log in.
